messages:
olivia: hey team — I just pushed a tiny Next.js + LlamaChain sample (slim path) to the repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-samples/tree/slim-llamabot. Can someone smoke-test the auth flow and the example eval harness wiring?

kevin: grabbing it now. quick Q: which SDK should this use by default? we have parity issues between js-sdk and py-sdk for refresh tokens.

olivia: prefer js-sdk (this is a starter for frontend/edge). but if it surfaces bugs we can add a py example later. main thing is minimal friction for first-run.

kevin: ran it locally — hit a token refresh loop when using the example OAuth creds. server logs show repeated 401 -> retry -> 401. snippet: 
```
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z ERROR auth Middleware: token refresh failed: invalid_grant
2026-03-20T18:12:03Z INFO retry: sleeping 100ms
2026-03-20T18:12:04Z ERROR auth Middleware: token refresh failed: invalid_grant
```

kevin: looks like the JS SDK's default retry handler retries on 401, but the API returns unrecoverable 401 for that client_id. we need to short-circuit and surface the error to the user instead of retrying.

sana: ugh. that matches a bug we saw in dedicated onboarding last month. quick fix is to treat 401/403 as non-retryable in the client when the request is the token refresh endpoint. can send a PR.

olivia: thanks. can we also update the starter README to call out env var expectations and the dev OAuth creds limitations? new devs keep hitting this and getting stuck.

priya: for the eval harness: I tried wiring the minimal eval runner to the sample prompts. it works but telemetry event names are inconsistent (js-sdk emits "eval_run" while our harness expects "eval:start"). small rename?

leo: yeah telemetry drift is painful. we should either adapt the harness to accept both event names, or add a shim in the sample that maps the js-sdk events to the harness format. prefer harness flexibility.

kevin: for the retry behavior, proposed defaults for frontend starter: maxRetries=1, baseBackoff=100ms, nonRetryStatusCodes=[400,401,403,422]. that will avoid spamming refresh endpoints.

sana: agree on nonRetryStatusCodes, but keep a note in the README about when to relax them (dedicated/private deployments with robust token rotation).

olivia: can we also add a tiny troubleshooting section with the common log lines and suggested fixes? like "if you see invalid_grant, check client_secret and redirect_uri"

devx-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for branch slim-llamabot — CI started (jobs: lint, tests: smoke-e2e). https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/9876

kevin: ping on the PR — I’ll open one with the non-retry change + README tweaks. also including a tiny fix to the example dev creds to not auto-rotate.

priya: I can update the eval harness to accept both event names and add a small test. will link PR.

leo: also adding a telemetry manifest to the sample so the console shows the right fields out of the box (short list: eventName, promptTokens, latencyMs, success).

olivia: awesome. once PRs land can someone run through the on-boarding checklist? I want to add this to the "quickstart" in docs.

kevin: will do. rough ETA — 2 hrs to open PR, 1-2 hrs review.

sana: merging the auth change after kevin's PR. I'll leave a comment with a minimal repro for QA.

priya: PR for eval harness posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-samples/pull/42 — adds event aliasing + test.

kevin: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dev-samples/pull/43 — changes retry rules + README.

olivia: thanks all. once merged I’ll update the docs and add a screenshot to the quickstart. :party_parrot: 

leo: fyi I ran the CI smoke-e2e on the branch — flaky test in headless chrome, unrelated. filing a separate issue.

olivia: noted — new issue would be great. marking this thread as resolved for the auth/retry + eval-harness steps.
